name: Sargatanas, the Knight Aflame
summary: Noble Spirit of honor and revenge, we invoke you from your grand house, we call you from the depths and invite you in. We promise you auspicious hosts and great deeds. Dwell in us and grant us your valor.
effects:
Fleeing, stepping down from a challenge, and acts of dishonor are all violations of his Pact. If you Fall to Sargatanas' Pact, you can choose to either die instantly, or transform into a Demon under his control forever.
Sargatanas' Pact can be used to make or resist Attacks with any Weapon, as if using a Skill. (The DC to Attack you becomes 8+Pact Strength, and your Attacks are 2d6+Pact Strength.) These Attacks cannot be Resisted by any Skill. When an Enemy fails a Melee Attack against your Pact Strength, they Provoke an Opportunity Attack from you.

attrs.invocation: Noble Spirit of honor and revenge, we invoke you from your grand house, we call you from the depths and invite you in. We promise you auspicious hosts and great deeds. Dwell in us and grant us your valor.
attrs.lore: Sargatanas was the Grand Brigadier of the Abyssal armies. In the battle with the Company of Fools, his forces were overmatched and he dispatched articles of surrender signed in blood. It is said that this was the first Contract of Binding, which preserved him from the ravages of the Doom.

name: Beelzebub, the Fly Unmade
summary: Oh voracious, Spirit of proliferation and hunger, we invoke you into our homes, we entice you from the earth with the scent of a thousand feasts. We promise you warmth and blood. Dwell in us and instruct us the art of consumption.
effects:
Failing to consume at least some of an Enemy's corpse after death or refusing to consume meat when available is a violation of his Pact. If you Fall to his Pact, you instantly transform into a violent, inchoate mass of flies that attempts to consume any and every living thing it can percieve.
Beelzebub's Pact gradually transforms the body into a roiling mass of insects, beginning with maggots that hatch from their flesh. This grants you benefits at the following thresholds:
You subtract your Pact Strength from your Strain and roll all Injury Risk with a Boon.
You gain an Unarmed Attack with your Jaws: Melee, +1_Accuracy, Cutting, Vicious.
When you inflict an Injury or hit a Corpse with this Attack, you shed half your Strain or 1 Persistent Strain.
When Damaged, you can shift into a cloud of flies as a 1 AP Reaction. This makes Cutting, crushing, and Piercing Damage Blunt against you for one Round. While in this form you gain a Flying Speed up to your Movement and can fit through gaps as small as 10 CM. You can also adopt this form with a Minute long incantation for 10 Minutes.

attrs.invocation: Oh voracious, Spirit of proliferation and hunger, we invoke you into our homes, we entice you from the earth with the scent of a thousand feasts. We promise you warmth and blood. Dwell in us and instruct us the art of consumption.
attrs.lore: The Overseer of the Basins of Rot. Beelzebub raised locusts, plagues, and all kinds of horror from these wells of putrescence. Beelzebub is dead, an exquisite corpse which continually overflows with waves of vilest hunger.

name: Agaliarept, the Sorcerer
summary: Spirit of intellect and subtlety, we invoke you with the name of whispers. We promise our secrets, to break the cyphers and to plunder the hidden place in your name. Dwell in us and lend us the virtue of your eyes.
effects:
When you learn a Secret, you gain a Charge which can be spent on any of Agaliarept's Hexes. You can hold a number of these up to thrice your Pact Strength. You can technically use a Hex without spending Charges, but this is a Violation of his Pact. Falling to agaliarept's Pact is simply lethal, killing you instantly.
| Charges: 1| Effects: You Touch an Object in Range, leaving an invisible Magical Eye. You can relocate your vision to the Magical Eye at any time as a 1 AP General Action. It can see in the dark as if it were day. You can only have Magical Eyes up to your Pact Strength and can disolve any you wish with the same Action.
| Charges: 2| Effects: You can make yourself invisible for the next Minute as a !0 AP Reaction. This makes you impervious to vision.
| Charges: 3| Effects: For the next Minute, you can speak and hear from a remote location as if there yourself. This can be in any place you know, with any Creature you have met or seen, or with any Object you have ever touched.
| Charges: 4| Effects: Touch a page or so worth of text as a 1 AP Interaction. You instantly understand its contents unless it is a Magical cypher with a Tier greater than your Pact Strength.
| Charges: 5| Effects: Touch a lock as a 1 Ap Interaction. Unless it is Magical with a Tier greater than your Pact Strength, it opens instantly. You can remotely re-seal it once as a 0 AP Reaction at any time or distance.
| Charges: 6| Effects: Think of an Object, Creature, or place that you know or have a reasonable description of (enough to describe it to another). You instantly know the shortest path to it and any hidden dangers between you and it.

attrs.invocation: Spirit of intellect and subtlety, we invoke you with the name of whispers. We promise our secrets, to break the cyphers and to plunder the hidden place in your name. Dwell in us and lend us the virtue of your eyes.
attrs.lore: Abbadon's armies did not act blindly. In the shadow, traitors and demons alike piled secrets on the altar of the Abyss' lord of whispers. After the Doom, Agaliarept found new and willing servants in the Binders of the Shard Sea.

name: Put Satanachia, the Black Ledger
summary: Spirit of desire and dominion, prince under the vault of flames, we invoke you into our circle and under the trigram, within the hex and pentagram. We honor you with ceremony and auspicious signs. Dwell in us and place your honey on our tongues.
effects:
The Codes of Put Satanachia are as follows, each of which constitutes a violation of his Pact if disobeyed:
Treat others with polite conduct unless they desire otherwise.
Refuse no offer of pleasure and inflict no harm, unless the victim themselves begs for pain.
Take no part in violence, unless under threat yourself.
Binders of Satanachia must also honor his desires. Failing to Satisfy him for more than a day and a night constitutes a violation. The following kinds of act are Satisfactory in this way:
Extravigant feasts, expensive and pompous.
Carnal union with a new partner.
Especially lecherous or debauched activity of any kind.
Falling to his Pact reduces the Binder to a gibbering predator, driven by depraved compulsions and sick thoughts.
You gain a Bonus to your Mind equal to your Pact Strength. Those whose Mind is less than yours are Vulnerable to you, and their Disposition towards you is greater by 1. If the difference is more than 6, their Disposition is greater by 2. If the difference is greater by 10, they must Coin-Flip to disobey your verbal commands.

attrs.invocation: Spirit of desire and dominion, prince under the vault of flames, we invoke you into our circle and under the trigram, within the hex and pentagram. We honor you with ceremony and auspicious signs. Dwell in us and place your honey on our tongues.
attrs.lore: The Grand Courtier of the Abyss, Put Satanachia was the first of the Demons that dealt with the Company of Fools. Forbidden by nature from the war of swords and missiles, his was the war of words and majesty.

name: Lucifuge Rofocal, the Golden Idolater
summary: Spirit of wealth and conservation, most prosperous and gleaming, we invoke you with gilt offerings. Dwell in us and bring us riches, gold and silver, gems and crystal, carved and precious, crowns and diadems to be heaped before your altar.
effects:
While Bound to Lucifuge, you can percieve Debts of all kinds as a kind of intangible sign, betraying its kind, but not to who it is owed, unless it is to you. You always know if you are the party to whom someone is in Debt, and can always percieve your own Debts. Debts also have a Magnitude, a measure of their import. What you are able to do with Debts depends on this, as the main ability offered by Lucifuge comes in Extracting a Price for a Debt.
Debts of Conscience can have no greater Magnitude than 3, and usually only reach 1. A Debt of the Third Magnitude in this case would stem from a feeling as strong as a life-debt or similar grave obligations like parental love.
Debts of Conscience for you count as a Violation if you allow them to dissuade you from gaining greater wealth or power.
Debts of Law have a Magnitude corresponding to the severity of the punishment entailed in failing to honor them. 1 for minor fines, 3 for incarceration, 6 for death.
When you incur these Debts, you must repay them within the time period of your Pact with Lucifuge or suffer a Violation.
This Debt stems from a Binding Pact, one which the Victim is made fully aware of. In exchange, you may set the terms, conditions, and the Magnitude of the Debt incurred.
You are also Bound by these Pacts, meaning that failing to honor your end is a Violation in the eyes of the Golden Idolater. Further, if you ever lie to the victim in this proceeding no Pact is formed and you suffer twice the normal Penalty.
You can Extract a Price, up to the Magnitude of the Debt or Pact Strength, whichever is lower. You may do so as often as you like, until the Debt is absolved either by you or by a change in the circumstance. For example, losing the emotional source for Conscience, the warrant of Law, or a breakage of a contract on your part for Volition. Extracting a Price is not an Action proper, and you can even perform this while Unconscious or Helpless.
You obtain agreement from the Target in some small matter (increasing their Attitude by 2), cause them to forget something within the last Day, or to mispercieve something small for 1 Minute.
You learn who they owe any of their Debts to, and why.
The Target falls under your control, operating as a mindless, blank-faced automata for the next Minute. They must obey you in all things. Alternatively, you can transfer an Injury or as many points of Strain (including Persistent) to them as you like.
You learn the total history of Debt the Target has ever accrued, as well as all those to whom they owed it, when, and why.
The Target falls Unconscious for 1 Minute. During this period, they suffer any Damage, Stress, Strain, or Corruption instead of you.
The Target is under your total control and must obey all commands you give until you absolve them of the Debt. Further, you can Extract any of the lesser Prices at will from them.

attrs.invocation: Spirit of wealth and conservation, most prosperous and gleaming, we invoke you with gilt offerings. Dwell in us and bring us riches, gold and silver, gems and crystal, carved and precious, crowns and diadems to be heaped before your altar.
attrs.lore: The Treasurer of the palaces in the Abyss, Lucifuge was and is a shrewd creature, willing to treat with any side able to afford his service. The Doom was, for him, no change at all, for avarice is eternal.

name: Lilith, the Queen in Shadow
summary: Oh noblest Spirit, empress of treachery and overturner of kings, we invoke you with a wetted crown of sharpened lead. She who cuts the throats of the judge and the regent, dwell in us and guide us in the path of Sedition.
effects:
To enter a Pact with Lilith, one must slay a loved one in her name. As you remain so-Bound, she may demand any life she wishes at GM discretion, often taking when and who would hurt the most. Any failure to honor these requests is terminal. You Fall instantly and are transformed into 72 writhing, vicious asps.
You gain the following benefits at the corresponding thresholds of Pact Strength:
Nothing can negate or Block Cutting or Piercing Damage. When your Target rolls Injury Risk, they roll twice and you choose the result.
A single Creature of your choice per Day chosen at dawn cannot perceive you at all unless you choose to let them. Likewise, they cannot Spot you. Neither benefit applies when you stand within a ring of salt.
If you Injure a Creature that does not Detect you, they die.

attrs.invocation: Oh noblest Spirit, empress of treachery and overturner of kings, we invoke you with a wetted crown of sharpened lead. She who cuts the throats of the judge and the regent, dwell in us and guide us in the path of Sedition.
attrs.lore: The only true daughter of Abbadon, Lilith ruled the host of Demons before the Doom. Only bested by the Company of Fools by means of treachery, she abandoned her nobility to sow unrest in the children of her enemy.

name: Lucifer, the Son of the Sun
summary: Oh Spirit of Glory, we invoke you from the endless sands of Perdition, against those ignorant, against the scorn of fools, in spite we name you King in Truth and promise you justice. Dwell in us put your might in our hands and your foes beneath our feet.
effects:
For every Round that you benefit from Lucifer's Pact, you must give up the benefits of all other Pacts. If you violate this exchange, you suffer 1 Corruption for each Round. Falling to Lucifer's Pact, you erupt in smoke malign flames. This kills you and subjects everying within (Your Pact Strength) times ten Meters to twice the normal Damage from the Flame of Perdition.
At any time, you can choose to Wield Perdition's Flame. This is not a Reaction or Action at all, and can be used even when Unconscious.
While Wielding the Flame, you are shrouded in a violet-yellow corona of incinerating Glory, moving you to the first place in Initiative regardless of rolls; if used during another Creature's Turn, you interrupt them. This also confers a Buff to all of your Abilities equal to your pact Strength, makes you immune to any Conditions or mental domination, and causes all Creatures within your Engagement to suffer Chaos Damage.
Each Round spent Wielding the Flame requires you to roll Chaos Dice equal to your Pact Strength, suffering 1 Corruption for each Die that rolls face 6.
If two Binders Wield the Flame at once, their Initiatives are used to break the tie in Turn order.

attrs.invocation: Oh Spirit of Glory, we invoke you from the endless sands of Perdition, against those ignorant, against the scorn of fools, in spite we name you King in Truth and promise you justice. Dwell in us put your might in our hands and your foes beneath our feet.
attrs.lore: The Spirit Lucifer is a jealous lord, covetous as he is violent, as magnificent as vicious. Unknown before the Doom, speculations wild as to his origin, from an incarnation of Verdun spite, an ascendant Binder, or even the Prince of Fools arisen as a new king of Hell.

name: Buer, Cloven in Pentacles
summary: She who nurtures the downtrodden, second mother to the beggar, thief, and first to the Witch, we call your name and invite into our hearth. Meet our hospitality with your own, spirit of transformation and magic, teach us your ways, give us gifts, dwell in us.
effects:
"Tread not the garden underfoot"-Buer regards the impoverished as her fruit, but with a gaze tolerant of tangles and thorns that most would recognize for weeds. Petty criminals, miscreants, thieves, pickpockets, beggars, orphans, urchins, and all rabble must be allowed to prosper in their own way, per the terms of your contract. Unless under threat of your own life or property, you are forbidden from interfering with them. Buer regards most misbehavior like a woodsman might slime and maggots, a necessary part of the lower world. Falling to Buer's Pact, apropos of her inclinations, causes your body to explode in a shower of filth laden with fertile spores and foul, nutritive juices.
To remove 1 Corruption at any time from yourself.
To increase your effective Pact Strength with Buer for the next Turn, by 1.
To shed a single point of Strain.
Over the course of 10 Minutes, you mix a foul-smelling mixture of animal fat, blood, and bile. Even if these ingredients were poisonous, the resultant concoction dispells Infections and speeds Recovery Time by a number of Days equal to your Pact Strength.
You cast a handful of knuckle-bones while focusing on a question, the GM will respond with either Weal or Woe, this takes 1 Minute, and you should remain cautious, as the meaning of Weal or Woe is ambiguous at best.
For 2 AP, you bring both hands your mouth and expel a fragrent cloud of Magic Spores in a Burst with a Radius equal to your Pact Strength, centered on you. Allies in this Burst gain a Buff of 1 to all Tests, and Enemies suffer an equal penalty. The cloud lasts for 1 Round, and gives rise to a ring of white-button mushrooms within the next Day, if possible. These are edible and lightly psycho-active.
For 1 AP, you pronounce a Curse on a Space within 6 Meters. Within 1d6+1 simple-Turns a maul of midnight blackness pounds the area, inflicting Crushing Damage.
For 3 AP, your eyes begin to shine with a ruby-amber light. Each Round thereafter for 1 Minute, you can Gaze at a Creature for !0 AP, you instantly learn their deepest fear, if any, and make them Vulnerable equal to your Pact Strength for 1 Full-Turn.
After spending 6 AP, you belch an acrid pall of roiling ebony smoke with a Radius of 6 Meters. Every Creature you choose with Willpower less than your Fellowship, Pact Strength, and Corruption is Blinded for 6 Minutes. If their Willpower is lower by 6, they also become Frenzied for 1 Minute, and you can control their Actions forced by Frenzy. If it is lower by 6 Again, you gain complete control of their Actions for their next Turn, leaving them Blind and Frenzied thereafter.

attrs.invocation: She who nurtures the downtrodden, second mother to the beggar, thief, and first to the Witch, we call your name and invite into our hearth. Meet our hospitality with your own, spirit of transformation and magic, teach us your ways, give us gifts, dwell in us.
attrs.lore: Ancient Buer, the Five-hooved Hag, Ork Mother, these are names from before, from the first Binders of Gaia, then called Witches. Hers is a less overtly sinister bargain, born from a kind of perverse maternity which she and her servants seem to genuinely espouse.

For 2 AP, you bring both hands your mouth and expel a fragrent cloud of Magic Spores in a Burst with a Radius equal to your Pact Strength, centered on you. Allies in this Burst gain a Buff of 1 to all Tests, and Enemies suffer an equal penalty. The cloud lasts for 1 Round, and gives rise to a ring of white-button mushrooms within the next Day, if possible. These are edible and lightly psycho-active.
For 1 AP, you pronounce a Curse on a Space within 6 Meters. Within 1d6+1 simple-Turns a maul of midnight blackness pounds the area, inflicting Crushing Damage.
For 3 AP, your eyes begin to shine with a ruby-amber light. Each Round thereafter for 1 Minute, you can Gaze at a Creature for !0 AP, you instantly learn their deepest fear, if any, and make them Vulnerable equal to your Pact Strength for 1 Full-Turn.
After spending 6 AP, you belch an acrid pall of roiling ebony smoke with a Radius of 6 Meters. Every Creature you choose with Willpower less than your Fellowship, Pact Strength, and Corruption is Blinded for 6 Minutes. If their Willpower is lower by 6, they also become Frenzied for 1 Minute, and you can control their Actions forced by Frenzy. If it is lower by 6 Again, you gain complete control of their Actions for their next Turn, leaving them Blind and Frenzied thereafter.
invocation: She who nurtures the downtrodden, second mother to the beggar, thief, and first to the Witch, we call your name and invite into our hearth. Meet our hospitality with your own, spirit of transformation and magic, teach us your ways, give us gifts, dwell in us.
lore: Ancient Buer, the Five-hooved Hag, Ork Mother, these are names from before, from the first Binders of Gaia, then called Witches. Hers is a less overtly sinister bargain, born from a kind of perverse maternity which she and her servants seem to genuinely espouse.
